deals.notes: The acquirer was to be a new fund, so its listing is not stated. The same proposal also covered Nuveen Mortgage Opportunity Term Fund 2 (JMT), not recorded here. The replacement proposals (charter amendment ending the term plus a tender offer) were then voted on at meetings adjourned to 2019-08-29; later filings show this CIK renamed Nuveen Mortgage and Income Fund, still ticker JLS, but the excerpts do not state how the tender offer ended.
